notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Publish Object Class Directed Interactions service-report implementation to the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab for §5.6. The focused real-filesystem case verifies that rejected undefined object or interaction class inputs append no successful-void record; an accepted supplied interaction-class set uses ObjectClassHandle type 36 plus InteractionClassHandleSet type 28; and a supplied empty set remains present as an empty array. It does not prove complete directed-interaction publication, subscription, routing, callback behavior, generic return/failure forms, public MOM publication, timestamped behavior, DDM, remote transport, JUnit/protected-review evidence, or conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void publishObjectClassDirectedInteractions( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, InteractionClassHandleSet const & interactionClasses) = 0
